long.vo: Five days at the Basin Reserve. Thirteen hundred and twenty-seven runs, twenty-four wickets, and no result. India declared on seven twenty for nine and needed eight wickets on the last day. They took three. This is how a Test India controlled slipped to a draw, and the two men who shut the door.

scene.sub: Five days, 1,327 runs, 24 wickets, no result.

long.vo: New Zealand three sixty-eight. India seven twenty for nine declared. New Zealand two thirty-nine for five. Henry Nicholls, one seventy-five not out, Player of the Match.

long.vo: It starts with the toss. India won it and bowled, and the pitch gave them every reason: fifteen millimetres of grass, and moisture on top. On the first morning, a bowler's dream.
Over one. जसप्रीत बुमराह, full, on the fourth-stump line, the seam upright. Tom Latham, sure it would leave, left it. It came back. Two for one.

scene.title: Bowled.
scene.name: LATHAM b BUMRAH
scene.caption: Latham left it, expecting it to go away. It came back.

long.vo: बुमराह had been here before: Wellington, twenty twenty, one wicket for eighty-eight in twenty-six overs. This time his first over had Latham.

foot: Bumrah, in the first innings of each Wellington Test.

long.vo: Devon Conway lasted three overs and one review. Given out caught behind, he was reprieved when the replay showed the noise came before the ball reached the bat. Then अंशुल कंबोज, full and seaming away: an edge, and twelve for two.

रचिन रवींद्र survived an edge India did not review. आकाश दीप got him anyway, with extra bounce. Next over, बुमराह's nipbacker found Daryl Mitchell's inside edge, and यशस्वी जायसवाल held it at short leg. Fifty-two for four.

long.vo: Then the day turned.

Over thirty: बुमराह nips one back at Glenn Phillips, who is on six. India review the lbw, the third umpire sees a spike, and the review is lost. Edges rolled past the stumps. And when Nicholls was on a hundred and two, a top edge was left by two fielders.

long.vo: Then the sun came out, and the pitch began to brown. False shots fell from twenty-five per cent before lunch to fourteen after. On good-length balls, from thirty to thirteen.
India drifted shorter. Nineteen per cent of their seam balls were short before lunch. After lunch, thirty-six.

long.vo: Henry Nicholls: a hundred and thirteen not out by the close, his fifth Test hundred at this ground. Glenn Phillips, ninety-four. A sixth-wicket stand of a hundred and seventy-three: fifty-four singles, seven twos, seven threes, twenty-one fours. Seventy-three per cent dots, and they never let India settle.
Look at their wagon wheels. Nicholls scored fifty-seven of his placed runs on the leg side, forty-two through the off.

long.vo: Phillips was the opposite: fifty-seven off the front foot through the off side, and only sixteen on the leg. Two different ways to wear India down.

long.vo: The day ended with one last twist: बुमराह, the second new ball, an inswinger at Henry Nicholls' toes. He jammed his bat down just in time. Two forty-three for five at stumps.

long.vo: Day two began on two forty-three for five. Henry Nicholls batted right through to one seventy-five not out. Glenn Phillips made his second Test hundred, a hundred and eighteen. They finished on three sixty-eight, and by then the green top had turned brown.
India's reply began with यशस्वी जायसवाल: eighty-five off eighty-nine balls, sixteen fours, sixty-four of his eighty-five in boundaries.

scene.name: JAISWAL
scene.caption: Out c Blundell b Henry, 130 for 1.

long.vo: But start with the squeeze. Before tea, eight overs, sixteen runs. Three slips and a gully. Kyle Jamieson finished the day with eleven overs, five maidens, fifteen runs.

Then the drama. Over four, New Zealand review an lbw against के एल राहुल, and lose it. Over seven, Matt Henry hits राहुल on the pads, two sounds, a huge appeal, and Tom Latham, with a second left on the clock, does not review. Henry throws his sweater down.

long.vo: And जायसवाल had two lives: on nought, an edge between third slip and gully; on six, an edge to gully, and Glenn Phillips drops it.

long.vo: After tea, a hundred and forty-three runs in thirty-one overs. Eight quiet overs, then the flood.

Look at his wheel: fifty-one of his placed runs through the off side, nineteen through the leg, and six straight.

long.vo: Day three. Three hundred and twenty-seven runs, three wickets, and every session faster than the last. Eighty before lunch, a hundred and five to tea, a hundred and forty-two after.
New Zealand began stump to stump. Before lunch, eighty-four per cent of balls were on or outside off. By the evening, a quarter were on the leg side.

long.vo: गिल's fifty was a pull for six, and it put India in front. Ninety-eight off a hundred and forty-six, nine fours, two sixes, mostly on the leg side.

long.vo: It is the fourth-highest score by an India captain in New Zealand. Only Azharuddin, twice, and Gavaskar have made more.

long.vo: Two records came out of this innings. The first seven partnerships all passed fifty, a new world record. And all five of India's top five went past fifty, only the fifth time in Test history.

long.vo: रिषभ पंत ended the day on fifty-five not out: fifteen off thirty-seven balls, then thirty-seven off the next eighteen, with two sixes in two balls off Duffy. The lead went past a hundred.

long.vo: Day four. India declare on seven twenty for nine, a lead of three fifty-two. It began with रिषभ पंत: a hundred, brought up with a six, a hundred and twenty-eight off a hundred and fifty-three balls, ten fours, six sixes.

scene.caption: Past Brendon McCullum on the Test sixes list.

long.vo: Look at the wheel: thirty-three runs through the off side, thirty-three through the leg, thirty straight. Three of the six sixes went down the ground.

long.vo: The man who paid was Glenn Phillips. Twenty-four overs, a hundred and fifty-four runs, nine sixes, seven of them today. He still took three wickets.
Then the lower order. Dhruv Jurel, seventy-eight off seventy-nine. The nightwatchman, अंशुल कंबोज, thirty-eight off forty-two. आकाश दीप, thirteen off five balls, two sixes.
Two hundred and thirty-four runs in forty-one overs, five point seven one an over. Then India declared.

Add it up. Jacob Duffy bowled thirty-three overs for two hundred and one, with seven no-balls. Phillips, a hundred and fifty-four for three. New Zealand's attack leaked runs at four point three five an over.
The reply. जसप्रीत बुमराह, second ball, Latham caught behind. Nought in the first innings, nought in the second. The third New Zealand captain with a Test pair, and the eighth New Zealand opener.

scene.mono: A PAIR · THE THIRD NZ CAPTAIN TO BAG ONE
scene.caption: The eighth by a New Zealand opener in Tests.

long.vo: Henry Nicholls, the first-innings centurion, lasted fifty-nine balls. प्रसिद्ध कृष्णा got one to jump, and Dhruv Jurel dived at short leg. Sixty for two.

scene.caption: The first-innings centurion goes for 31 off 59.

long.vo: India's plan shifted. In the first twenty-two overs, twenty-seven per cent of the balls were short. After Nicholls, forty-five, and a quarter on the leg side.

long.vo: But Devon Conway and रचिन रवींद्र settled. Fifty-nine unbeaten. Their control went from eighty-two per cent in the first thirty overs to ninety-nine in the next fifteen.

long.vo: Day five. India needed eight wickets, and New Zealand needed to bat the day. One point six runs an over. Eighty-six per cent of balls were dots. Thirty-four maidens in seventy-five overs. Blocking, by plan.
The conditions gave India little: a twenty-two kilometre breeze, sixteen degrees, dead grass, a dried-out pitch.

scene.caption: Over three hundred balls between them. Not one more wicket.

long.vo: Sixty-three unbeaten, off two hundred and fifty-nine balls, forty-three overs. When India finally shook hands, the two of them walked off to applause.

long.vo: Mitchell scored forty-nine off a hundred and eighty-six balls. Of the runs we can place, sixteen went through the off side, sixteen through the leg, and none straight down the ground.

long.vo: Forty-three overs is the second-longest stand like it by New Zealand this century. The record, a hundred and twenty-three overs, was set on this ground, against India, in twenty fourteen.

long.vo: India bowled well. प्रसिद्ध कृष्णा: eleven overs, eight maidens, three runs. Forty-two maidens in the innings, the most by any team in this cycle.
So, did they quit too soon? With about an hour left, Mitchell offered his hand and शुभमन गिल took it. Three wickets in seventy-five overs, one every twenty-five. India needed five.

long.description:
India vs New Zealand, 1st Test analysis (Basin Reserve, Wellington, 19-23 November 2026): India needed eight wickets on the last day and took three. The full story in five acts: Bumrah on a green top, New Zealand's 368 and the afternoon the pitch eased, India's 720 for 9 declared (Jaiswal, Rahul, Padikkal, Gill, Pant, and a record seven 50+ stands), Latham's pair, and the Mitchell and Phillips wall that saved the draw. Wagon wheels, pitch maps from above, line and length maps, the WTC cost, and the question: did India give up too soon?

CHAPTERS are listed below. YOUR CALL: who wins the series? Comment 1 India, 2 a second draw, 3 New Zealand.
